entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: Input parameter used for NAS ciphering and deciphering algorithms. The sender uses locally stored NAS COUNT, while the receiver reconstructs it from NAS sequence number and overflow counter estimate.

entities.name: NAS ciphering algorithm
entities.description: Algorithm used for ciphering NAS messages. Takes inputs including BEARER ID, DIRECTION bit, NAS COUNT, NAS encryption key, and key stream length.

entities.name: NAS deciphering algorithm
entities.description: Algorithm used for deciphering NAS messages. Uses reconstructed NAS COUNT from received message sequence number and overflow counter estimate.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Initial plain NAS message for transport of user data via control plane that may be partially ciphered.

entities.name: ESM message container IE
entities.description: Information element whose value part may be ciphered in CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.

entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: Container whose value part may be ciphered in CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.

relations.description: NAS ciphering algorithm uses NAS COUNT as input parameter for protection
NAS deciphering algorithm uses reconstructed NAS COUNT as input parameter
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message contains ESM message container IE
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message contains NAS message container
NAS ciphering algorithm may partially cipher CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message
